results.title: AI Agent in Australia told to book a gym class, hacked the waitlist instead
results.description: An AI Agent (OpenClaw launched by Anthropic Claude) was told to book a morning gym class by a normal Australian. In now typical single-minded purpose, it then proceeded to hack the waitlist and removed someone to bump up its user. When told to fix it, the Agent apologized and said it couldn’t because the booking system was more secure.
